description: Plumbing explains the system that brings clean water into a home and carries waste away: health and safety, supply and drainage systems, tools, terms and pipe types, hands-on supervised repairs, and careers.

safety.note: Shut off the water before repairs and work with an adult; soldering with a torch requires direct adult supervision.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Requirements 6 and 7 were revised in 2025 and the excerpts disagreed about their content, so they are not outlined yet.
